prompts.text:
Precise production keyframe revision of this THREE-CELL mushroom-nest sheet. The user wants a MUCH DEEPER, LONGER DOWNWARD DRAPE during growth. Keep this exact left-to-right small/medium/adult progression, fixed camera, common square cell coordinates, original ivory cradle sizes, original ground contacts and palette. Three equal square cells in one horizontal strip, transparent RGBA background, no labels or grid.
Change ONLY the salmon MUSHROOM CAP pose in ALL THREE cells. The current caps flare sideways like shallow roofs and leave almost the whole ivory basket exposed; this is wrong. Instead, the SAME cap must lengthen downward and CURL ALL THE WAY DOWN AROUND THE FRONT AND BOTH SIDES of the nest, enveloping it deeply like a thick soft protective bell-shaped mushroom hood. Its front edge and side edges droop almost to the bottom of the ivory cradle. Cover at least80-85percent of the currently visible ivory cradle. Only a THIN LOW crescent of the ORIGINAL ivory base should peek out at the bottom. At512px cell coordinates the lowest cradle remains y448, while the cap's long drooping front hem reaches about y420-430, rather than currenty360. The side hems also reachy415-430, not horizontally flared wing tips. The original salmon dome flows continuously into these long down-curled skirts; keep one connected smooth organic mushroom surface, with a little burgundy underside only where the hem curls. Preserve cap volume and original painterly light/shadow, do not just squash or vertically move the existing roof.
All three are FULLY DEEPLY CLOSED throughout: SMALL deeply wrapped pose, MEDIUM deeply wrapped growing pose, ADULT deeply wrapped pose with growth complete but cap still fully down. Keep the deeply enveloping posture in every cell. No visible eggs, neck, vents, wooden collar or bellows, all remain sheltered INSIDE this closed cap. Do not enlarge or redesign the ivory cradle to make coverage easier. NO hanging separate tentacles, fingers, cloth seams, fabric folds, holes, drips, extra cap lobes, faces or extra mushrooms. This remains the exact soft coral mushroom nest in the reference. No horizontal open umbrella edges above the basket. No background, glow, particles, cast shadow or text. These are the ACTUAL three revised animation key drawings for user review.

Precise local correction to these THREE production mushroom keyframes. Keep the exact positions, small-medium-adult progression, unchanged underlying ivory cradle dimensions, cap apex positions, widths, style, light, palette, transparency and3-cell layout. The cap side skirts now droop correctly, but the FRONT still leaves a broad ivory basket exposed. Make the coral cap's CENTRAL FRONT HEM drape substantially LOWER and FORWARD over the visible ivory front rim, covering nearly all of it. Extend the same continuous mushroom surface downward, so only a VERY THIN ivory bottom crescent is visible: about10-18pixels high on a512px cell, rather than the current50-60pixels. At512px coordinates bottom of ivory cradle remains y448, red front hem should reach y430-437. ALL THREE cells must show this same deeply wrapped protective posture while growing. Do not shorten, shrink, remove, redesign or reshape the ivory cradle; actually OCCLUDE it with the extended coral canopy. The side skirts should smoothly join the lower front hem and wrap around both sides. Keep one intact rounded bell-like mushroom cap, no extra lobes or separate parts, no new seam lines, no tentacles, no split hood. No exposed eggs, stems or equipment. No camera movement or enlargement of the whole nest. Genuine RGBA transparent background. No text, particles, glow or shadows. Only deepen the lower cap coverage.
